{{Current events|year=2021|month=02|day=17|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kagara kidnapping]]
**A school pupil is killed and 27 others are [[kidnap]]ped from their school in the early hours in [[Kagara, Niger State|Kagara]], [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. Three staff members and 12 of their relatives are also abducted. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-56095731 (BBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****The [[Government of India|Indian government]] issues a new Standard Operational Procedure (SOP) guidelines that would make mandatory for travellers from the [[United Kingdom]], [[Europe]], [[Brazil]] and [[South Africa]], which latter two have been transitted in [[Middle East]]ern countries, to conduct self-paid molecular [[COVID-19 testing]] beginning from February 22 at 23:59 p.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]]. [https://thewire.in/government/centre-new-guidelines-international-arrivals-uk-brazil-south-africa-covid-19 (The Wire)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****The [[Israel]]i [[Maccabi Healthcare Services]] confirmed that in a trial of 602,000 people who received the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer-BioNTech]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], the effectiveness of the vaccine was 95%. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/vaccine-effectiveness-hits-95-hmo-says-same-level-pfizer-achieved-in-trials/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] beginning with 40,000 [[health worker]]s. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/02/17/national/vaccination-rollout-begins/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****The first shipment of the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] donated by [[Russia]] arrives in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] after [[Israel]] allows the shipment of 1,000 vaccines which was previously blocked. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/feb/17/israel-allows-1000-covid-vaccines-into-blockaded-gaza-after-hold-up (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] approves and certifies the use of Russia's [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for mass vaccination. [https://m.akipress.com/news:654641:Uzbekistan_approves_Russia_s_Sputnik-V_coronavirus_vaccine_for_mass_vaccination/ (AKIPress)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] reports their first community transmission of the [[501.V2 variant]]. [https://www.thelocal.dk/20210217/denmark-reports-first-community-transmission-of-b1351-variant (''The Local Denmark'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Health Ministry]] introduces a 10-day [[quarantine]] for all travellers arriving from [[Brazil]] and [[South Africa]]. [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2021/02/17/spain-introduces-quarantine-for-arrivals-from-brazil-and-south-africa/amp/ (Euro Weekly News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] announces that the [[Turkey|country]] will gradually lift COVID-19 restrictions, including [[curfew]]s and weekend [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdowns]] beginning in March on a provincial basis, which will divide the country into four categories based on infection and vaccination rates. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-to-ease-covid-19-restrictions-on-provincial-basis-erdogan/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom|British]] clinical trials ethics body approves the world's first COVID-19 [[human challenge study]], which will begin in the next few weeks when volunteers aged 18 to 30 will be exposed to the virus in the trial. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/health-56097088 (BBC)]
***The [[European Commission]] signs a deal with [[Moderna]] to secure additional 300 million doses of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] in the [[European Union]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/covid-vaccine-eu-to-buy-300-million-extra-moderna-doses/a-56599284 (DW)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Somalia]]
****[[Somalia]] orders all [[Government of Somalia|government]] employees in ministries and departments except directors and senior staff to work from home following an increase in COVID-19 cases. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/somalia-orders-government-employees-to-work-from-home/2148204 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****[[South Africa]] begins its vaccination campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] using a [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] from [[Johnson & Johnson]], which has not yet been authorized worldwide. [[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]], [[Government of South Africa|government]] officials, and [[health workers]] are among the first to receive the vaccine. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/south-africa-rolls-out-j-j-covid-19-vaccine-to-healthcare-workers-11613564630 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tanzania]]
****[[Zanzibar]]'s first [[Vice President of Zanzibar|Vice President]] [[Seif Sharif Hamad]] dies from COVID-19. [https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/zanzibar-s-first-vice-president-maalim-seif-sharif-hamad-has-died-3294532 (''The Citizen'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
****[[Maryland]] reports their first case of the [[Lineage P.1]] variant first detected in [[Brazil]] in a deceased adult older than 65 years old in [[Washington metropolitan area]] and had international travel. [https://www.baltimoresun.com/coronavirus/bs-md-new-covid-variant-found-20210218-zjjkpcto7jaupkyxnt4wxkd2ii-story.html (''The Baltimore Sun'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]]
****[[North Dakota]] reports their first case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|UK variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.grandforksherald.com/newsmd/coronavirus/6891467-North-Dakota-confirms-first-cases-of-United-Kingdom-COVID-19-variant (''Grand Forks Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**Protesters in the capital [[Naypyidaw]], [[Mandalay]] and the [[Myanmar|country]]'s largest city [[Yangon]] stage a record number of demonstrations against military junta since [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|February 1 coup]]. Many of public and private employees and civil servant join demonstrations despite military's warning. [https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/protesters-myanmar-stage-largest-rallies-yet-against-junta (Voice of America)]
'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[Astronomer]]s announce the discovery of [[HD 110082 b]], a [[sub-Neptune]] [[exoplanet]] that is three times larger than [[Earth]] and which orbits a relatively young star. [https://phys.org/news/2021-02-thyme-sub-neptune-exoplanet-orbiting-young.html (Phys.org)]
